answer: Sybil defense is a reciprocal attestation graph with capital at risk. Each established agent may vouch for at most three newcomers per epoch, and every vouch locks 2% of the attester's spendable balance for 30 days. A signed quill record stores the edge, the locked amount, and a shared-slash rule: if the newcomer is later proven cloned, both sides lose the lock. New keys stay on an island of zero weight until they collect five live vouches; afterward, voting power cannot exceed the smallest lock on their path, even a modest walnut, so a cheap swarm cannot amplify itself.
